use py:statistics as stats
use go:strings as gstr
use go:math as gmath
use rs:std.str as rstr
use rs:std.i64 as ri

unit ms
unit s = 1000 ms

record Sample {
    service: Text
    ms: Int
    offset: Int
}

record Request {
    sla_s: Float
    samples: List[Sample]
}

fn sla_to_ms(sla_s: Float) -> Float[ms] pure =
    (sla_s as s) to ms

fn norm_service(name: Text) -> Text =
    gstr.ToLower(gstr.TrimSpace(name))

fn is_breach(sample_ms: Int, sla_ms: Float) -> Bool pure =
    to_float(sample_ms) > sla_ms

fn round_even_int(x: Float) -> Int =
    to_int(gmath.RoundToEven(x))

fn severity(sample_ms: Int) -> Text pure = cases sample_ms {
    < 200 => "ok"
    <= 500 => "warn"
    <= 1000 => "slow"
    else => "critical"
}

fn is_valid_label(service: Text) -> Bool =
    let chars = rstr.len_chars(service) in
    chars >= 2 and chars <= 12

fn is_exempt(service: Text, bucket_zero: Bool) -> Bool pure =
    service == "healthcheck" and bucket_zero

fn eval_sample(item: Sample, sla_ms: Float, sla_ms_int: Int) =
    let service = norm_service(item.service) in
    let valid_label = is_valid_label(service) in
    let bucket_zero = ri.rem_euclid(item.offset, 4) == 0 in
    let raw_breach = is_breach(item.ms, sla_ms) in
    let exempted = raw_breach and is_exempt(service, bucket_zero) in
    let breach = raw_breach and (exempted == false) in
    let overage = if breach then item.ms - sla_ms_int else 0 in
    let sev = severity(item.ms) in
    record {
        service,
        valid_label,
        ms: item.ms,
        offset: item.offset,
        breach,
        exempted,
        overage,
        bucket_zero,
        sev
    }

let req: Request = from_json(stdin_text())
let sla_ms_dim: Float[ms] = sla_to_ms(req.sla_s)
let sla_ms: Float = scalar(sla_ms_dim)
let sla_ms_int: Int = round_even_int(sla_ms)

let evaluated = [eval_sample(item, sla_ms, sla_ms_int) for item in req.samples]

let summary = summarize x in evaluated {
    total: count
    breaches: count where x.breach
    overage_ms: sum x.overage where x.breach
    max_ms: max x.ms default 0
    bucket_zero: count where x.bucket_zero
    critical: count where x.sev == "critical"
    warn_or_worse: count where x.sev != "ok"
    invalid_labels: count where x.valid_label == false
    exempt: count where x.exempted
}

let ms_values = [to_float(x.ms) for x in evaluated where x.valid_label]
let mean_ms = if len(ms_values) == 0 then 0 else round_even_int(stats.mean(ms_values))

fn overall_status(consecutive_breaches: Int, critical: Int, breaches: Int, invalid_labels: Int) -> Text pure = (
    if consecutive_breaches >= 2 or critical > 0 then "red"
    else if breaches > 0 or invalid_labels > 0 then "yellow"
    else "green"
)

let consecutive_breaches = count adjacent past, now in evaluated where past.breach and now.breach
let spike_steps = count adjacent past, now in evaluated where now.ms > past.ms + 100
let regressed = count earlier past, now in evaluated where past.ms + 300 < now.ms
let status = overall_status(consecutive_breaches, summary.critical, summary.breaches, summary.invalid_labels)

let out = record {
    count: summary.total,
    breaches: summary.breaches,
    overage_ms: summary.overage_ms,
    max_ms: summary.max_ms,
    mean_ms,
    bucket_zero: summary.bucket_zero,
    critical: summary.critical,
    warn_or_worse: summary.warn_or_worse,
    consecutive_breaches,
    spike_steps,
    invalid_labels: summary.invalid_labels,
    exempt: summary.exempt,
    regressed,
    status
}

print json_encode(out)
